Pull a Table from the CUNY Sports Database

Source: R/cuny_pull_table.R
cuny_pull_table.Rd

Retrieves a complete table from the SQLite database included with the CUNYsports package and returns it as an R data frame.

Usage

cuny_pull_table(x)

Arguments

x

A character string specifying the name of the table to retrieve.

Value

A data frame containing the requested table.

Details

Use [cuny_table_names()] to view the tables currently available in the CUNY Sports database.

Examples

cuny_pull_table("basketball_all_seasons_team_final")
